notes: Racer handling: steering is now progressive at speed. A tap is a small correction and holding the key builds to a full-grip turn (before, any touch at 200 km/h was already the limit). Gamepads steer with the stick by how far you push it, and the right trigger feathers the throttle. The chase camera looks into corners. Sharper models everywhere: fighters, hoopers, cars and the arenas have bevelled edges that catch the light, tyres have rounded shoulders and finer tread, cars have wheel-arch flares, and the ball, rims and hoop are smoother. Tip: Settings → Pixel size → Fine shows the extra detail best.
